description: TISSEO - Itinéraires is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tisséo Voyageurs. Représentation cartographique des itinéraires tout mode (bus, Linéo, métro, tramway, téléphérique, scolaire) du réseau de transport en commun de Tisséo en service et données attributaires associées. Un itinéraire est une suite ordonnée de tronçons inter-arrêts desservant une suite ordonnée d'arrêts. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are itineraire, bus, metro, tramway, lineo, téléphérique. The portal shows 371 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
